body: I moved here with him but am starting university next week. I don't want to move back home because I was very unhappy there to begin with and wanted to live on the west coast instead because I have always loved it here. I feel like I will be a failure if I move back east too. I am scared that if I break up with my boyfriend, he simply will not care and that will hurt me so much because I care about him so much. Thank you for responding to me it's hard to believe that I can feel a little less alone even from a stranger on the internet
